user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Web pages crawled for ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon direct user prompt or GPT Actions request.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to train and enhance generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web content for model development and AI training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to user queries.
user_agents.scope: Performs user-initiated requests when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Indexes and evaluates content specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes and crawl for Google Search and other products.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl news content.
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shopping-related web content.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Execute Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and product teams.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible content for internal R&D without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs across Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs across Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl sites requested by owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents building crawls requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control use of content for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically or in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology and features across Apple products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web crawler for Apple search features including Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or apply robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage of crawled data for training foundation models powering Apple Intelligence features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Crawls only URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Meta platforms.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-webindexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for improving advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalads in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training foundation AI models or improving products through indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to complete tasks and evaluate agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content to provide accurate customer information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Eligible web content for search experiences; does not train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or standard search bot rules.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to support user actions and queries.
user_agents.scope: Live information fetching on user behalf; not for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Samples a randomly selected subset of the web via HTTP GET requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow in robots.txt for CCBot or request addition to opt-out registry.
